source_title: Lock In a Darkhold Destiny Collector Booster Early With The Arcanum Bundle at Amazon
source_excerpt:
Magic’s next Marvel set (after 2025’s Spider-Man and 2026’s Super Heroes), will be Darkhold Destiny next year .
We predicted we’d get something spooky from Marvel’s collaboration with Wizards of the Coast, but we also thought X-Men might come sooner.
In any case, we’re excited for the likes of Blade and Doctor Strange, and the Arcanum Bundle is back in stock at Amazon.
Grab This Magic x Marvel Bundle Before It Sells Out Again
Magic: The Gathering | Marvel: Darkhold Destiny Arcanum Bundle
The Arcanum Bundle is the latest in a long line of “Gift Bundle” options , with this one including three foil mythic rare promos, a Collector Booster, and 8 Play Boosters, as well as full-art lands, a special die, and a storage box.
All in all, you’re basically paying the same price you’d pay for each piece separately with the MSRP here, but you are at least avoiding a markup - for now.
That Collector Booster (and, potentially, the promo cards) is likely to see interest from scalpers and prices climbing accordingly. After all, Collector Boosters are around $40 alone, but can include the set’s rarest cards (although we don’t yet know what those will be).
Still, if you’re keen on placing your order, we’d recommend doing it soon.
In case you missed it, Darkhold Destiny is one of four sets confirmed for 2027 so far, alongside Nauctis: The Sunken Realm, Kamigawa: Titanbreach, and Zhalfir.
For more on Magic: The Gathering, be sure to check out our rundown of the best Commander preconstructed decks of all time , and Wizards of the Coast’s comments on product fatigue .
